scenes.text: How many days pass from the 2th to the 5th of the same month (not counting the first day)? Let us think carefully. Count forward 3 days. The answer is 3. Great work!
How many days pass from the 3th to the 7th of the same month (not counting the first day)? Let us think carefully. Count forward 4 days. The answer is 4. Great work!
How many days pass from the 4th to the 9th of the same month (not counting the first day)? Let us think carefully. Count forward 5 days. The answer is 5. Great work!
How many days pass from the 5th to the 11th of the same month (not counting the first day)? Let us think carefully. Count forward 6 days. The answer is 6. Great work!
